source_note: 自然数的r次幂的部分和估计
english_source_note: Partial Sum Estimates for Powers of Integers
callout_id: 自然数的r次幂的部分和估计#2
statement_en:
Find an asymptotic expansion of
$$S(N):=\zeta(2)-\sum_{n\leq N}\frac{1}{n^2}$$
with the coefficient of $\frac{1}{N}$ determined exactly.
callout_body: 求$$S(N):=\zeta(2)-\sum_{n\leq N}\frac{1}{n^2}$$的精确到$\frac{1}{N}$系数的渐近展开。
